description: Permanently delete a saved transactional email template by ID or slug. Use this to retire an obsolete template: the slug stops sending and becomes free to reuse. Already-sent deliveries and their stats are kept, so history and analytics survive the delete. The linked email content stays as a reusable template and comes back as `deleted.emailId`; pass that to `delete_template` to remove the content too. Code-managed emails (`managedBy: code`) are the exception: their content snapshot is deleted with them and `deleted.emailDeleted` is true. To stop sends without losing the template, call `update_transactional_email` with `enabled` set to false instead.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

idOrSlug.description: Transactional email ID or API slug, for example `welcome-email`.

name: delete_transactional_email

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `delete_transactional_email` MCP tool.

deleted.description: Deleted transactional email: id, slug, name, emailId of the email content, and emailDeleted (true for code-managed emails, whose content snapshot was deleted; false when the content was kept as a reusable template).

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
